business_meaning: Savings product type for the account
documented_rules: Allowed values: EASY_ACCESS, FIXED_1Y, NOTICE_90, ISA
inferred_rules: If ProductCode = FIXED_1Y then AccountMaturityDate must be populated; product determines interest/withdrawal rules

documented_rules: Allowed values: OPEN, CLOSED, DORMANT, FROZEN; AccountCloseDate mandatory when AccountStatus = CLOSED; Balance must be 0.00 when AccountStatus = CLOSED
inferred_rules: If AccountStatus = 'CLOSED' then Balance = 0.00; status should match snapshot status in facts
Currency should be a 3-character ISO code; expect 'GBP' for all rows
AccountOpenDate must be earlier than AccountMaturityDate when AccountMaturityDate is populated; should be <= today

documented_rules: Mandatory when ProductCode = FIXED_1Y; AccountOpenDate must be earlier than AccountMaturityDate
inferred_rules: If populated, AccountMaturityDate > AccountOpenDate; not populated for non-term products
If AccountStatus != 'CLOSED' then AccountCloseDate should be null; AccountCloseDate should be >= AccountOpenDate and <= today

business_meaning: Annual interest rate (%) applicable to the account
inferred_rules: InterestRate should be a non-negative decimal; for FIXED_1Y it should match product fixed rate; may be recorded at fact-level daily
Balance should be >= 0.00 (unless overdrafts allowed, which is NOT documented); daily fact balances should reconcile across days

business_meaning: SCD2 version start datetime for this row
documented_rules: Curate keeps history using ValidFrom; used as LoadDate for facts
inferred_rules: For current row ValidFrom <= ValidTo; ValidFrom represents the effective-from timestamp for the version; used as fact LoadDate

business_meaning: SCD2 version end datetime for this row
documented_rules: Curate keeps history using ValidTo; 9999-12-31 indicates current version
inferred_rules: ValidTo must be > ValidFrom; current version uses '9999-12-31' as convention; validity ranges must not overlap for same AccountNumber

business_meaning: ETL load timestamp captured during ingestion
documented_rules: Fact LoadDate/LoadTimestamp is taken from Curate ValidFrom or Curate load date
inferred_rules: LoadTimestamp should be populated for every load and represent the ELT execution time; used to order loads and determine current version
